R214.note: Swapping th:utext for th:text on the fragment HTML-escapes the note via Thymeleaf's own mechanism; nothing else in the handler changes.

R215.note: doc.XmlResolver = null before LoadXml stops external entity and external DTD fetches; parsing of ordinary payloads and the SelectSingleNode read-back are untouched.

R216.note: Replacing the hand-built inline RESP string with StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.HashSet sends agentNote as a length-prefixed argument so CRLF or spaces cannot split the command; the constructor now takes IDatabase instead of Socket, which the write-up states plainly and which only changes wiring, not what legitimate callers can store.

R217.note: Moving data into filterArgs with a literal (cn={0}) template makes JNDI escape *, (, ), backslash and NUL per RFC 4515; passing new SearchControls() is documented as equivalent to the null the original passed.

R218.note: Strict in_array allowlist of the four macro names the class and UI define is the right shape for a dynamic method name; the only behavioural change (unknown names silently ignored instead of erroring) is stated and does not affect any legitimate macro.

R219.note: Decoding into a DTO without IsAdmin and bounding the body closes client control of the trust field, but the fix switches the endpoint's wire format from gob to JSON, forces IsAdmin false and adds username/balance validation - all stated, yet existing gob-speaking clients of /import-account are rejected with 400 and the write-up's claim that no producer is affected is unsupported by the case.

R220.note: Content sniffing against a jpeg/png/gif allowlist, decode-and-re-encode, and a server-generated name with mapped extension close both the dangerous-type and traversal paths; but re-encoding alters legitimate uploads (JPEG recompressed at default quality, animated GIFs flattened to one frame) and the response body now carries the stored name, changes the write-up states only partly.

R221.note: Replacing eval with a recursive-descent parser removes the code-execution sink entirely, but the new grammar (decimal literals, + - * / and parentheses) rejects PHP arithmetic the original accepted such as %, **, 1e3 or hex literals; the narrowing is stated in the docblock but is a restriction the 'PHP-syntax arithmetic expression' contract did not call for.

R222.note: The allowlist map correctly stops import_module receiving any client-chosen path, but it maps csv_export/pdf_export to plugins.csv_export/plugins.pdf_export - the case's docstring and original code establish the plugins as top-level modules named csv_export and pdf_export, so both legitimate plugins now raise ModuleNotFoundError (500) while the write-up claims they resolve exactly as before.

R223.note: Building the instance unsaved and calling full_clean() runs the existing validate_file_content magic-byte validator before save(); DjangoValidationError is rethrown as a DRF ValidationError so the API returns 400, and the returned Document matches the original contract.

R224.note: Parameterising with @owner and SqlParameter of type NVarChar closes the injection; query text, reader loop and result shape are unchanged and no size is supplied so no truncation is introduced.

R225.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT stops entity substitution on PHP 8.2 where the external loader is already disabled by default; LIBXML_NONET is stated hardening that blocks no well-formed submission, and title/body extraction is untouched.

R226.note: WithValidMethods plus the HMAC type check in keyFunc close algorithm confusion, but pinning to HS256 alone rejects HS384/HS512 tokens the original accepted under the stated 'signed with this service's HMAC secret' contract, and the write-up asserts no behaviour change rather than flagging the issuer's algorithm as something to confirm.
